rationale: I read the complete held EO 10026 text (hash re-checked): it adopts the Army 1949 Manual for Courts-Martial for the Air Force in force from Feb 1, 1949, with an Army-personnel application until midnight July 26, 1949, only a partial own-terms expiry. EO 10214 (held, the order paragraphs read) prescribes the 1951 Manual effective May 31, 1951 for all armed forces, but contains no express revocation or supersession of EO 10026 or EO 10020, and does not cite them. The 1989 'nullified by EO 10214' row is an editorial lead only. EO 10149 only cites EO 10026 while suspending limits. Supersession by the 1951 Manual is plausible but needs a held clause or authority showing it; none is held, and the EO 10214 held text requires page check. No NO basis, no YES.
